description:
Create the empty crate scaffold for jmap-metadata-server, cookie-cut from jmap-sharing-server (closest single-extension-server analog).

## Deliverables

- New directory crate-jmap-metadata-server/
- Cargo.toml: name=jmap-metadata-server, deps {jmap-types, jmap-metadata-types, jmap-server, serde_json}, dev-deps {tokio, jmap-metadata-server with memory feature}; mirror sharing-server's [features] memory = []
- src/lib.rs: forbid(unsafe_code), pub mod backend/metadata/helpers, cfg(feature='memory') pub mod memory, pub use re-exports, register_metadata_handlers function, JMAP_METADATA_URI re-export
- src/backend.rs: trait stub (MetadataBackend: JmapBackend) — only the method signatures (no body)
- src/metadata.rs: handler function stubs — signature only with todo!() body
- src/helpers.rs: extract_account_id re-export, SetAccumulators struct, finalize_set_response, set_error_value (copied from sharing-server pattern)
- PLAN.md, README.md mirroring sharing-server (substituting Metadata for Principal/ShareNotification)
- Workspace Cargo.toml: add 'crate-jmap-metadata-server' to members; jmap-metadata-server path-dep entry
- Workspace AGENTS.md: update crate map table to add jmap-metadata-server row, dep tree to add the new crate

## Acceptance
- cargo check -p jmap-metadata-server clean (todos in body OK; trait stub compiles)
- cargo clippy -p jmap-metadata-server -- -D warnings clean
- cargo doc -p jmap-metadata-server --no-deps clean
- Workspace build: cargo check --workspace clean

## Out of scope
- Real handler bodies (deferred to .3.3)
- Real backend trait method bodies — only signatures (.3.2 fleshes out)
- Memory backend (.3.4)
- Integration tests (.3.4)
title: Scaffold jmap-metadata-server crate (Cargo.toml, lib.rs shell, register_metadata_handlers, workspace member, README/PLAN.md)
